title: Automate Support Replies with Zoho Desk and Claude #Shorts

angle.problem: Customer support agents spend half their day retyping the exact same answers to repetitive support tickets.
angle.solution: Trigger a Deluge function on ticket creation that sends the customer issue to Claude's API and automatically posts a formatted draft answer as a private comment.
steps: In Zoho Desk, go to Setup -> Automation -> Workflow Rules and create a rule on Tickets upon 'Created'.
Add a Custom Function using invokeurl to send ticket description and subject to Claude API (api.anthropic.com/v1/messages).
Use zoho.desk.createComment() to inject the generated AI response into the ticket as an internal private comment for agent 1-click review.
angle.result: Cuts ticket resolution time by 70% while ensuring support answers remain accurate, personalized, and human-approved.
angle.wow: The support agent opens a brand-new ticket and the full technical solution is already waiting as an editable draft comment.
angle.hook: Your support reps are typing the same reply fifty times today.
